Formed in Nashville in the early 2000s while performing as side-men with stalwarts of the bluegrass community, the band members soaked up every influence like musical sponges. Their friendships, paired with a shared drive to create their own music and master their own destiny, inevitably led to the birth of The Infamous Stringdusters. item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This out and back hike replaces the hike that I scheduled for Monday at Thompson Creek. I may adjust this hike on the fly due to trail conditions after the storm but we have many options along this area of the MST to go different routes. Hopefully we will have some nice leaf colors. This will be the longest and most elevation gain of the routes we would take and because it is an out and back you can shorten if you want. The trail may be muddy and slippery and we may encounter downed trees so please be prepared and capable for these conditions. item.title: Profile to Swinging Bridge FITNESS HIKE 11.9 miles 3450' ascent — Wed Oct 14, 10:10 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This is a very challenging 11.9 miles out and back hike starting at the Profile Trailhead. It is rated as difficult due to the rocky terrain and steepness. At the 2.7 miles mark we'll stop to take a look at the Profile view. This is the rock that gives the trail its name. At the end of the Profile Trail we'll take a right on to the Grandfather trail towards the swinging bridge. This 2 miles (one way) trail is very challenging as it includes rock scrambling, cables and ladders. Our next stop will be at Macrae peak. At 5,844 feet, this point offers a spectacular 360 degree view (one of the best views east of the Rocky Mountains). After this we'll continue climbing until we reach the swinging bridge before we turn around. If we have enough time we can stop at other points of interest such as the Attic window and Indian cave.
The total elevation gain is closer to 3,450 feet. To attend this event you must be doing very strenuous hikes . This trip is not recommend
